narrative_prose: Kaio adjusted the brass chronometer in the dim interior observatory, attempting to DEFEND the humming machinery against the violent glow of the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea. If left uncalibrated, it threatened a system-wide blackout (first why), corrupted vital survey data (second why), and ultimately blinding the colony to incoming storms (third why). Intending to CONCEAL the worst of the damage, Kaio turned and tossed the heavy calibration wrench to Ryn, who was attempting to CONSUME the remaining diagnostic rations. "Seal the vents!" Kaio shouted as Ryn grabbed the heavy iron wrench from mid-air.
